rulebook.title: BWF Laws of Badminton V5.0 (in force 26 April 2025; new Laws with 3x15 scoring from 4 January 2027, Law 9 unchanged per secondary sources)
rulebook.text_used: search extracts and GitHub copies of the Laws (bwf.sport not reachable); fault numbers in Law 13 follow an older edition

line_width_m.note: white or yellow, part of the area they bound

scene.text: Court 13.40 x 6.10 m with 40 mm white or yellow lines; net 1.524 m high at the centre and 1.55 m at the posts, dark mesh with a 75 mm white top tape.

Umpire on a high chair at one end of the net, service judge on a low chair at the opposite post, line judges behind or beside their lines; with the fixed-height rule a 1.15 m service-height device stands by the court.
Feathered shuttlecock with 16 white feathers and a cork base; one racket per player, strings in a crossed pattern.

fouls.title: Service height
fouls.text: At the instant of being hit by the server's racket the whole shuttle must be below 1.15 m from the court surface.
fouls.legal: the whole shuttle is below 1.15 m when struck

fouls.title: Server's feet
fouls.text: Some part of both feet of the server and receiver must remain in contact with the court in a stationary position until the service is delivered.
fouls.legal: both of the server's feet are on the court

fouls.title: Base of the shuttle first
fouls.text: The server's racket must initially hit the base (cork) of the shuttle.
fouls.legal: the racket meets the cork first

fouls.title: Touching the net
fouls.text: It is a fault if a player touches the net or its supports with the racket, person or dress while the shuttle is in play.

fouls.title: Hitting over the net
fouls.text: Invading the opponent's court over the net with racket or person is a fault, except following through after the contact was made on the striker's side.
fouls.legal: shuttle and racket are on the player's own side of the net

fouls.title: Sling or double hit
fouls.text: The shuttle may not be caught and held on the racket and then slung, nor hit twice in succession by the same player.
